channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Amit Shah Launches Bharat Taxi, India’s First Cooperative Ride-Hailing App With Zero Commission
item.description: Union Minister Amit Shah launches Bharat Taxi, a driver-owned cooperative app with zero commissions and lower fares.

item.title: Singapore Transforms Ocean Plastic into Durable Public Furniture, Making Circular Economy Visible to Citizens
item.description: Singapore’s innovative programme recycles ocean-bound plastic into benches, decking, and fixtures, promoting sustainability and public awareness.

item.title: Rudrankksh Patil Ends Seven-Year Men’s Air Rifle Gold Drought for India at Asian Championships
item.description: India achieves a historic double podium in men’s 10m air rifle and clinches team gold in New Delhi.

item.title: India Win Record Sixth U-19 World Cup After Crushing England in 2026 Final
item.description: India secured a historic sixth Under-19 World Cup title by defeating England after Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking century.

item.title: Trump Lifts 25% Russia Tariff on India; Joint Trade Framework Announced
item.description: The US and India unveiled an interim trade framework cutting tariffs, easing tensions over Russian oil, and paving the way for a broader bilateral trade agreement.

item.title: Four Bengaluru Family Members Found Hanging in Bihar Dharamshala Under Mysterious Circumstances
item.description: A family of four from Bengaluru was found dead inside a Rajgir dharamshala room, with police investigating whether the deaths were suicide or murder.

item.title: Pappu Yadav Arrested in 1995 Forgery Case After Midnight Standoff at Patna Residence
item.description: Patna Police arrested Purnea MP Pappu Yadav after a late-night standoff regarding a thirty-year-old forgery and property case.

item.title: Gurugram Assault Horror: Three-Year-Old Girl Allegedly Sexually Abused by Two Women and Male Accomplice, Probe On
item.description: A three-year-old girl in Gurugram’s Sector 54 was allegedly sexually assaulted by two domestic helps, prompting a POCSO investigation.

item.title: Delhi Police Register FIR Against DJB Officials and Contractor After 25-Year-Old Biker Dies in 20-Foot Pit
item.description: A 25-year-old Delhi bank employee died after his motorcycle plunged into an open 20-foot pit dug by the Delhi Jal Board, sparking allegations of negligence and poor safety measures.

item.title: Tirupati Laddu Row: Chandrababu Naidu Alleges Use of Bathroom Chemicals in Ghee
item.description: Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu alleges industrial bathroom cleaning chemicals were used to adulterate Tirupati temple's ghee.
